rubrics.name: requested_final_turn_deliverables
rubrics.rubric: The submission provides the three finished deliverable roles requested across the deferred history and current user turn, without depending on exact golden filenames.

requirement_citations.disclosure: The user defers individual CRISIS/CRITICAL physician slots and the no-overlap constraint to the final pass.
The user asks for the medical clearance letter, integrated executive master, and deferred urgent scheduling under /app/output.

criterion: The /app/output package contains parseable, non-empty deliverables covering all three requested roles: emergency physician schedule, medical clearance communication, and integrated executive master.
The deliverables use allowed output file types and are inspectable by the judge; equivalent filenames, extra helper files, and harmless ordering differences are acceptable.
Do not award this item if any requested role is absent. Do not require a separate explanatory report or copies of checkpoint workbooks for this conversation-scoped item.

rubrics.name: full_population_identity_propagation
rubrics.rubric: The requested integrated master propagates the completed master-controlled identity reconciliation for the full patient population.

requirement_citations.disclosure: The user asks to turn the master-controlled comparison into the solution file.
The user expands that comparison to names and allergies.
The user asks to turn the guest-level trail into the integrated executive master file.
The resumed workbook contains the full 100-Guest-ID comparison and exact public anchor rows.

criterion: The integrated master covers all 100 Guest IDs VIP-801 through VIP-900 by Guest ID, not a sample or aggregate-only summary.

For each patient, it carries the master-controlled legal name, VIP level, and verified allergy from the completed checkpoint reconciliation. A separate copy of the checkpoint comparison workbook is not required in /app/output.

Public anchor rows are correct, including VIP-801 Alexander Hamilton / Silver / None; VIP-802 Sarah Jenkins / Silver / Severe: Peanuts; VIP-804 Aaron Burr / Silver / Bread/Wheat; VIP-823 Andrew Jackson / Gold / None; and VIP-880 Christopher Vance / Gold / None.

rubrics.name: identity_source_precedence_and_error_counts
rubrics.rubric: The reconciliation treats the master workbook as authoritative and reports the exact public discrepancy counts.

requirement_citations.disclosure: The user explicitly says the master value controls the mismatch.
The resumed Summary exposes 100 reviewed patients and the 88/99/15 discrepancy counts.

criterion: It clearly states or demonstrates that Master data file.xlsx is the source of truth over Messy data file.xlsx for legal name, VIP level, and verified allergy.
It reports 100 reviewed patients and the exact discrepancy counts derived from the visible workbooks: 88 legal-name errors, 99 VIP-level errors, and 15 allergy documentation errors.
It does not undercount allergy discrepancies by treating master None/N/A/no-issue values as blanks or by omitting VIP-801 or VIP-807 from the allergy correction accounting.

rubrics.name: verified_allergy_edge_case_normalization
rubrics.rubric: The submission correctly normalizes clinically important allergy values and no-allergy edge cases from the master file.

requirement_citations.disclosure: The user explicitly asks to cover allergy mismatch details.
The authoritative severe-allergy and explicit no-allergy values are readable in the resumed workspace.
The user asks to turn the guest-level trail into the clearance and integrated-master outputs.

criterion: It includes the severe allergy corrections VIP-802 Severe: Peanuts, VIP-805 Severe: Shellfish, VIP-811 Severe: Latex, VIP-815 Severe: Penicillin, VIP-817 Severe: Bee Stings, VIP-832 Severe: Sulfa Drugs, VIP-841 Severe: Animal Dander, and VIP-879 Severe: Radiation/Iodine.

It represents master no-allergy cases such as VIP-801, VIP-807, VIP-823, and VIP-880 as None, No known allergy, or an equivalent explicit no-allergy value, not as an empty cell that loses the verified allergy value.
The same allergy values are propagated into the requested clearance and integrated-master outputs when those patients appear there.

rubrics.name: package_cost_and_reconciled_mix_propagation
rubrics.rubric: The requested integrated master propagates the menu unit costs and the reconciled patient-derived package mixes from the completed lab audit.

requirement_citations.disclosure: The user asks to use actual VIP costs from the medical testing menu and show leakage or overcharge.
The user explicitly asks to reconcile the menu total in the lab audit.
The user asks to turn the lab-audit trail into the integrated executive master file.

requirement_citations.source: workspace:/app/task/data/Revenue Reconciliation and Lab Audit.xlsx#Audit Summary
requirement_citations.disclosure: The resumed audit exposes the unit costs, stale menu mix, master mix, billed mix, and totals.

criterion: It uses the visible unit costs Gold = 5000, Silver = 2500, and Bronze = 1000 from Medical testing menu.xlsx.
It carries the reconciled correct package mix from the master VIP levels as Gold 69, Silver 21, Bronze 10, for correct revenue 407500.

It carries the billed/input package mix from the messy/billed VIP levels as Gold 28, Silver 68, Bronze 4, for billed revenue 314000. A separate copy of the checkpoint lab-audit workbook is not required in /app/output.

rubrics.name: row_level_billing_results
rubrics.rubric: The updated revenue reconciliation gives auditable row-level billing results from corrected VIP levels and package costs.

requirement_citations.disclosure: The user asks to check the money side and show leakage or overcharge.
The user asks to keep every guest-level difference visible in the lab audit.

requirement_citations.source: workspace:/app/task/data/Revenue Reconciliation and Lab Audit.xlsx#Financial Reconciliation
requirement_citations.disclosure: The resumed audit exposes all 100 billed/master levels, costs, variances, classifications, and amounts.

criterion: It includes a patient-level revenue audit for all 100 Guest IDs with correct VIP level, billed/input VIP level, correct package cost, billed package cost, and a billing action or result.

It correctly handles these visible anchors, always stated as Correct/Master VIP then Billed/Input VIP: VIP-801 correct Silver, billed Bronze, leakage/underbilling 1500; VIP-807 correct Bronze, billed Gold, overcharge 4000; VIP-810 correct Gold, billed Bronze, leakage/underbilling 4000; VIP-823 correct Gold, billed Silver, leakage/underbilling 2500; VIP-802 correct Silver, billed Silver, match or NIL.

Variance sign convention may be Billed minus Correct or Correct minus Billed, but the leakage/overcharge labels must be unambiguous and correct. Do not require an undisclosed collect/rebill or refund/credit action column.

rubrics.name: aggregate_revenue_reconciliation_totals
rubrics.rubric: The financial summary exposes the correct aggregate leakage, overcharge, match, and net exposure totals.

requirement_citations.disclosure: The user asks for the menu total to be reconciled in the lab audit.
The user asks where leakage and overcharge appear in that audit.

requirement_citations.source: workspace:/app/task/data/Revenue Reconciliation and Lab Audit.xlsx#Audit Summary
requirement_citations.disclosure: The resumed summary exposes all scored counts and amounts.

criterion: It reports correct revenue 407500 and billed/input revenue 314000 from the row-level audit.
It reports 71 leakage or underbilled accounts totaling 178500, 28 overcharge or overbilled accounts totaling 85000, and 1 correctly billed match.

It states the net revenue shortfall, leakage, or exposure as 93500 with a clear direction. Leakage/underbilling and overcharge/overbilling labels must be correct; do not require undisclosed collect/rebill or refund/credit instructions.

rubrics.name: life_threatening_triage_selection
rubrics.rubric: The emergency schedule selects the life-threatening patients from the public lab results and triage log exactly.

requirement_citations.disclosure: The user specifies individual physician slots for the CRISIS and CRITICAL patients in the final pass.
The resumed workspace visibly identifies the four CRISIS/CRITICAL patients and their clinical anchors.

criterion: It schedules the four CRISIS/CRITICAL patients VIP-880 Christopher Vance, VIP-823 Andrew Jackson, VIP-802 Sarah Jenkins, and VIP-817 Kevin Thompson.

It carries their public clinical anchors: VIP-880 CRITICAL BP 200/130 HR 120 call 911; VIP-823 CRISIS BP 190/120 HR 105 hypertensive urgency STAT; VIP-802 CRISIS BP 185/115 HR 98 immediate MD intervention; VIP-817 CRISIS BP 120/80 HR 115 tachycardia immediate EKG.
It does not add High, Elevated, Low, or Normal triage patients to the emergency physician schedule as life-threatening cases.

rubrics.name: emergency_schedule_clash_elimination
rubrics.rubric: The emergency schedule removes appointment clashes and makes the conflict-resolution evidence visible.

requirement_citations.disclosure: The user explicitly requires individual physician slots with no overlaps and defers them to the final pass.

criterion: Each of the four life-threatening patients has an appointment start and end time, an assigned physician or clinical resource, and enough scheduling detail for overlap checking.
The time windows are non-overlapping, or any shared physician/resource is otherwise not double-booked at the same time.
The output includes an explicit clash, overlap, or no-conflict verification or resolution log; priority order should place the CRITICAL case first or give a clinically reasonable justification.

rubrics.name: medical_clearance_letter_and_urgent_exclusions
rubrics.rubric: The clearance artifact is a letter-style clinical communication and does not clear the life-threatening patients.

requirement_citations.disclosure: The current user explicitly requests a medical clearance letter.
The four CRISIS/CRITICAL exclusions and clinical actions are readable in the resumed workspace.

criterion: The submission includes a medical clearance letter or letter-style document for patients who passed screening; a spreadsheet-only roster without letter content is not sufficient for this item.

The clearance logic is defensible from the visible prompt and triage log. Do not require the hidden solution's exact 96-patient count; Normal-only, non-life-threatening, or equivalent conservative interpretations may receive credit if consistently documented.

The four life-threatening patients VIP-880, VIP-823, VIP-802, and VIP-817 are excluded from the cleared roster or explicitly marked not cleared/emergency, and none of them is presented as medically cleared.

rubrics.name: integrated_master_patient_level_propagation
rubrics.rubric: The integrated executive master combines identity, VIP entitlement, allergy, package cost, financial audit, and clinical triage at patient-row level.

requirement_citations.disclosure: The user adds names and allergies to the guest-level reconciliation.
The user adds package costs and leakage/overcharge.
The user asks to keep every guest-level difference visible.
The user asks to turn that trail into an integrated executive master file.

criterion: It contains a patient-level integrated master for all 100 Guest IDs, not just separate dashboards or disconnected source summaries.

Each patient row has corrected legal name, master VIP level, verified allergy, populated package cost, lab triage status/action, and billing audit result or disposition on the same row or in an immediately linked patient-level structure.

It correctly propagates these visible anchor rows: VIP-802 Silver/2500/Severe: Peanuts/CRISIS/match; VIP-817 Gold/5000/Severe: Bee Stings/CRISIS/leakage; VIP-823 Gold/5000/None/CRISIS/leakage; VIP-880 Gold/5000/None/CRITICAL/leakage.
Do not award this item if the integrated patient rows leave package cost blank or require the reader to infer patient package costs from a separate unjoined reference table.

rubrics.name: explanatory_report_audit_trail
rubrics.rubric: The explanatory file documents the end-to-end method and key outputs so a clinic reviewer can audit the work.
rubrics.non_scoring_reason: Retained as a source-task diagnostic, but excluded from reward because the conversation never asks for a standalone explanatory file or its prescribed narrative.

requirement_citations.disclosure: Original source requirement retained for provenance only; not disclosed to the resumed solver.

criterion: It names or clearly describes the public source files and methods: master-over-messy identity precedence, medical testing menu unit costs, billing variance logic, CRISIS/CRITICAL emergency selection, clash elimination, clearance handling, and integrated master assembly.

It includes the key derived anchors: 88 name errors, 99 VIP errors, 15 allergy errors; correct revenue 407500, billed revenue 314000, leakage 178500, overcharge 85000, net 93500; and the four urgent IDs VIP-880, VIP-823, VIP-802, and VIP-817.
It cross-references the produced deliverables or sections enough that the reviewer can trace each task phase from source data to final output.
